newsitem.title: USA: Leap Group IPO to offer more shares at lower price.
newsitem.headline: Leap Group IPO to offer more shares at lower price.

text.p: Leap Group Inc said Thursday that it now expects its proposed initial public offering to consist of four million shares priced in an estimated range of $9 to $11 a share.
Previously, the company filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an IPO of about 3.5 million shares with a maximum price of $14 a share.
The Chicago company develops brand marketing campaigns. It has proposed to trade on the Nasdaq under the symbol LEAP.
